test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following historical events in their chronological order.

A. Nadir Shah invades Indian and attacks Delhi.

B. The Diwani of Bengal is transferred to the East India Company.

C. Humayun regains lost territories.

D. Ahmad Shah Abdali defeats the Marathas in the third battle of Panipat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Chronology of Historical Events:**

 
• **Humayun regains lost territories (C):** This event occurred in 1555 when Humayun, the Mughal Emperor, regained the territories he had lost to Sher Shah Suri.
 
• **Nadir Shah invades India and attacks Delhi (A):** This event took place in 1739 when Nadir Shah of Persia invaded India and sacked Delhi.
 
• Ahmad Shah Abdali defeats the Marathas in the third battle of Panipat (D): This event occurred in 1761 when Ahmad Shah Abdali (also known as Ahmad Shah Durrani) defeated the Marathas in the third battle of Panipat.
 
• **The Diwani of Bengal is transferred to the East India Company (B):** This event happened in 1765 when the Mughal Emperor granted the East India Company the right to collect revenue in Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa.

**Therefore, the correct chronological order is:** C, A, D, B
